examples.label: Team listing header with an invite action
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-header" site="Global" class="mb-8">
  Team members
  <:subtitle>Everyone with access to this workspace, and what they are allowed to change.</:subtitle>
  <:actions>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary" icon="hero-user-plus">Invite member</.component>
  </:actions>
</.component>

examples.label: Billing settings header with two actions
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-header" site="Global" class="mb-8 border-b border-zinc-200 pb-6"> Billing <:subtitle>Your plan renews on 12 September. Invoices are emailed to the workspace owner. <:actions>
<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="outline" color="natural" icon="hero-arrow-down-tray">Download invoices <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary">Change plan

examples.label: Centered marketing section header above a feature grid
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-header" site="Global" class="text-center"> Everything a small team needs <:subtitle>No add-ons and no per-seat surprises. The whole CMS is in every plan.
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-bolt" class="size-6 text-indigo-600" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-h6" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-3">Instant publishing <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 text-zinc-600">Changes go live the moment you press publish, with no rebuild queue.
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-shield-check" class="size-6 text-indigo-600" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-h6" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-3">Roles that fit <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 text-zinc-600">Give writers the editor and nothing else. Permissions are per site.
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-clock" class="size-6 text-indigo-600" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-h6" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-3">Full history <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 text-zinc-600">Every version of every page is kept, so you can roll back at any time.
